supersedes: For new training-sufficiency diagnostic attempts, presence of a compute process alone is no longer a rejection reason. Older strict-preflight attempts remain historical.
interpretation: Free memory is capacity; utilization.gpu and utilization.memory are coarse recent activity proxies, not exact free SM counts or guaranteed throughput. All three samples must meet gates; other compute processes are recorded, not rejected automatically.
preserved_constraints: Scientific package, checkpoints, saved-state population, inputs, random plans, metrics and tolerances unchanged.
One GPU per fresh attempt; absolute 600 seconds from before preflight; allocated memory at most 24 GiB, not a 24 GiB reservation.
First identity/timeout/OOM/nonfinite/count/software fault stops the queue; no in-attempt retry/fallback/deadline reset.
Do not stop or modify unrelated processes. Use the project GPU lock to avoid concurrent project queues.
Create a new implementation manifest and concrete execution record for this explicit resource-policy change; preserve old evidence.
